meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from pathway/objectives, Universe/galaxy/solar-system prose, planet profiles and visual, dwarf planets, Moon, asteroids/comets/meteors, Earth motions, seasons, Earth spheres, summary/glossary, exercises, picture study, puzzle, activities and ICT. Outside corrections are not silently inserted.
source_notes: This file is stored as term-1/unit-5.json to avoid collision with History Units 1–4; display_unit=1 keeps the learner-facing Geography unit number correct.
Both English and Tamil 2025 books were used. Geography Unit 1 uses printed pages 160–175 in both editions.
Only clearly legible facts from the planet-at-a-glance image were used; uncertain tiny-print numerical values were omitted.

The chapter contains source-specific/outdated astronomy statements, including Saturn having 62 satellites and Jupiter having the largest number; these are preserved only as textbook facts and not silently updated from outside knowledge.
The chapter says dwarf planets are found beyond Neptune while also listing Ceres; that wording is preserved as source content rather than reconciled externally.
The prose and diagram differ slightly on some solstice labels/dates; the bank uses the explicit prose/exercise dates (21 June and 22 December).

Open-ended exercise items whose answers require information not supplied in the chapter, such as the exact number of overhead-Sun occurrences at 20°N or the reason rotation speed is zero at the poles, are not supplied with outside answers.
